pages.text: A rune is not a command word. It is a small statement about a value: a number, a direction, an observer, a boundary, or an intended effect.$(br2)Links between runes must agree about what is being passed. A player cannot become a vector by accident, and a position cannot be treated as an effect. This is why the notation is typed.

pages.title: Marks And Anchors
pages.text: Rune chalk records notation at a place. A rune anchor gives that notation a stable point of reference in the world.$(br2)The graph is the demonstration. The final effect rune is the only part allowed to alter the world; the preceding runes explain why it may do so.
